live_baseline.inference: Repeated immutable proof IO and a full call-table timestamp scan are measured hotspots; file-cache attribution is an inference, not a separately measured stage.

mandatory_linux_regression.required_parent: Repository validation / validate depends on validate-operability-resources reusable workflow
mandatory_linux_regression.command: uv run --locked --managed-python python -B tests/operability_bounded_call_profile.py cgroup-suite --root local/resource-proof
mandatory_linux_regression.fixture_cache_eviction: fsync followed by advisory posix_fadvise DONTNEED on synthetic fixture files only; residency is not independently verified
mandatory_linux_regression.baseline_falsifier: Exact historical scan/member-read counters or independently observed cgroup oom-kill/timeout; ordinary launch/data failures never qualify
mandatory_linux_regression.acceptance: Each repaired CLI <512 MiB / <120 seconds; doubled-history peak <=1.25x+8MiB, wall <=1.5x+1s; exact diagnostics and no old payload reads
mandatory_linux_regression.peak_capture: Stdlib kernel memory.peak reader before cgroup disposal, shared with ordinary report units; InvocationID-scoped journal readback. Same-unit numeric MemoryMax/peak plus completed consumer and monotonic clocks required.
